focus_areas: Texture realism of the ice cream (air cells vs. noise)
Physical plausibility of the chocolate shavings (edges, shadows)
Contact boundary between ice cream and plate (melting behavior)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the chocolate shavings. In AI images, small garnish items often fail to cast proper shadows or have unrealistic geometry. Also, evaluate the 'melting' behavior: does it look like viscous fluid dynamics or just blurry pixels? The classifier should easily identify this as ice cream, but the perceptual auditor needs to check for 'waxy' or 'plastic' textures common in generative models.
image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a serving of vanilla ice cream on a white square plate. The ice cream consists of roughly two scoops that are partially melted and merging. There are dark brown chocolate shavings or curls scattered on top of the ice cream and on the plate. The texture appears creamy with visible air pockets and slight melting at the edges.

expert_testimonies.reason: To ensure the ice cream sits correctly on the plate with appropriate depth cues and contact shadows, avoiding floating or sinking artifacts.
To confirm the specific classification of the food item and distinguish it from similar textures like mashed potatoes or frosting.
To verify if the chocolate pieces are distinct objects sitting on top of the ice cream or if they are artifacts fused into the surface.
To assess the realism of the lighting, shadows, and texture details, specifically looking for AI-generated smoothness or lack of micro-detail.

The image seems to have a slight lack of sharpness, but this could also be due to the texture of the ice cream and the angle at which the photo was taken.
